done_when: on a domain without a month field, a single month filter becomes the answer's period whatever partial period the model also sent; the open, last-1-month and end-only shapes seen live all reach the plant picker, and only a conflicting explicit from-to period is still rejected; leaves per shape

findings.body: The three new acceptance cases call `ChatService.ask` directly through `makeFixture`, which supplies fake dimensions, repositories, executor, and a synthetic Bedrock response. The explicit-conflict case is likewise covered only at provider level. There is no test through the running API with a real database and browser flow, so the required user-facing proof is missing; regressions in request transport, real plant lookup, or frontend rendering could still pass every added test.
findings.title: Not done: partial statement windows reach the plant picker through the running app

why: Statement questions still fail when the model sends the month with an open, relative or end-only period
